svg.title: WarHeatMap: live global conflict intelligence, free
svg.desc: Cover for the WarHeatMap repository. A dot-matrix world map with the last seven days of events from the public warheatmap.app feed as of 2026-11-02, coloured by severity: critical rose, high gold, medium teal, low green. Left: the WarHeatMap wordmark, the line "Live global conflict intelligence, free", and three promises: a cited source on every event, a permanent page per event, no login and no ads.
